Subject: Kickoff: Vendor intake & portal account creation — HollyPack

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with Redwood. We're excited to get HollyPack set up in our procurement systems so PO issuance and invoice routing are smooth. To get started I created a short intake checklist (attached) and have outlined immediate asks below.

Quick overview / ask list:
- Confirm primary finance contact for billing & ACH (name, email, phone).
- Confirm whether HollyPack prefers Coupa or Ivalua as the primary portal for POs. We currently push POs to both for test purchases.
- Please upload a completed W-9 (PDF) or notify finance if you are non-US.
- Note: we use SSO/email domain verification for portal accounts. If you use an alias (e.g., s.patel@hollypack.com), please confirm which address will accept the invite.

Next steps we will take on our side:
- Open a manual vendor profile in Coupa to prevent PO hold if automatic invite fails.
- Share the vendor intake checklist attached.
- Create a support ticket with Coupa/Ivalua (depending on your preference) if you hit account creation errors.

Could you please confirm the finance contact and attach the W-9? If you run into any account creation errors, paste the error text in a reply and we'll triage immediately.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I hear from you and after we create the portal ticket.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

- I’m attaching the W-9 as a PDF. It was generated by our accounting system and shows EIN: 12-3456789.

Attached: W-9_HollyPack.pdf

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the W-9 and for flagging the alias issue. Two short items from our side:

1) Tax ID validation: the EIN on the PDF looks fine (12-3456789). Coupa sometimes rejects uploads if the W-9 metadata doesn't match the EIN field during the automated parsing step. We'll open a Coupa support case to confirm parsing behavior and attach your PDF so they can reconcile.

2) Email alias mismatch: that can block SSO mapping if the invite is sent to a different mailbox than the PO routing address. Workaround options:
   - We can send the Coupa invite to s.patel@hollypack.com instead of sanjay.patel@hollypack.com (preferred short-term).
   - If you want to keep the invite to sanjay.patel@hollypack.com, we’ll add s.patel@hollypack.com as an alternate contact on the vendor profile so POs route correctly.

Immediate plan (what I'll do now):
- Create a manual vendor record in Coupa and set the alternate contact to s.patel@hollypack.com so POs are not blocked (internal ticket RED-7962).
- Open Coupa support case (Case #C-112903) with the W-9 attached to investigate the EIN parse error.
- If you prefer, we can re-send the portal invite to the alias — let me know which address you want.

Can you confirm which email address you prefer for the invite and whether HollyPack is fine with us creating a manual vendor record (this will let us issue a one-off PO while portal access is resolved)?

Thanks — copying Aditya who will coordinate billing terms once the vendor profile is active.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Vendor Enablement Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: (attached to Coupa support case: W-9_HollyPack.pdf)

- Coupa support case opened (C-112903) with W-9 attached to investigate the EIN parse/validation.
- I’ve sent a DocuSign PO link to the billing contact so you can review the test PO while access is being fixed: https://app.docusign.com/link/CB12345-PO-approval

I'll follow up once Coupa responds to C-112903. If you prefer a phone call to iron out the alias mapping, I can schedule a 15-min slot tomorrow — propose 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks again — we should have the one-off PO completed within 24 hours.
